test_discipline.tests_in_run_all: tests/release/test-rc6-final-migration.sh and tests/release/test-acceptance-package.sh are in tests/run-all.sh. The acceptance-package test uses fixed synthetic fixtures (mktemp-based) and does NOT require the current-HEAD final package to pre-exist. The migration test discovers ALL *.json files in docs/migrations/, validates schema on each, and binds only the ACTIVE migration (to_head == current HEAD, applied=true) against the current DWM fixture + on-disk files. Historical migrations get schema-only validation.
test_discipline.current_head_gate_outside_run_all: scripts/acceptance/check-current-head-package.sh runs OUTSIDE tests/run-all.sh and is the only place that requires the final acceptance package to exist for the current HEAD. It runs only after a real canonical run has produced a passing full-suite NDJSON. This split eliminates the circular dependency where the full suite required its own evidence to exist before running.
